description: HTTP conformance scenarios replayed by conformance/mock-server.mjs. See conformance/README.md for the matcher syntax and the per-language runner contract.

scenarios.name: list_auto_pagination
scenarios.description: Iterates every item across three pages. The first request carries the filters (array filters as repeated keys); continue requests send only cursor and limit. Reads carry no Idempotency-Key.

scenarios.name: list_first_page_only
scenarios.description: Awaiting the list without iterating returns the first page with its cursor fields and sends exactly one request.

scenarios.name: list_cursor_expired_raises_with_progress
scenarios.description: The continue request gets 410 CURSOR_EXPIRED. The iterator raises CursorExpiredError carrying the items yielded so far, the pages served and the last item's id and updatedAt. It never restarts the query.

scenarios.name: list_network_error_replays_same_cursor
scenarios.description: The connection drops while fetching page 2. The iterator resends the same cursor (the server replays the page) and no item is skipped or duplicated.

scenarios.name: platform_list_pagination_without_end_user
scenarios.description: endUsers.list paginates with platform keyset cursors and never sends Daapi-End-User-Id, even when the client has a default end user.

scenarios.name: create_retries_with_same_idempotency_key
scenarios.description: A create gets 503 with Daapi-Should-Retry: true and is retried with the same generated Idempotency-Key (a UUID). Money is sent as a decimal string and quantity as a number.

scenarios.name: create_network_drop_retries_with_same_key

scenarios.name: create_uses_caller_idempotency_key

scenarios.name: non_json_error_body
scenarios.description: A 502 with an HTML body and no Daapi-Should-Retry header (for example from a proxy) is not retried and raises the base API error class with the HTTP status.

scenarios.name: update_sends_null_to_clear_and_omits_unset
scenarios.description: An explicit null is sent as JSON null (clears the field); fields the caller did not set are omitted.

scenarios.name: void_is_a_write
scenarios.description: void posts to /void with an Idempotency-Key and no body.

scenarios.name: per_call_end_user_and_server_timeout
scenarios.description: A per-call end user overrides the client default and serverTimeoutSeconds sends Daapi-Timeout-Seconds.

scenarios.name: missing_end_user_fails_locally
scenarios.description: A QuickBooks Desktop operation without an end user fails before sending any request.

scenarios.name: invalid_api_key_fails_locally
scenarios.description: A malformed secret key (bad checksum) fails before sending any request.

scenarios.name: with_response_exposes_request_id_and_headers
scenarios.description: Raw response access returns the parsed result plus the HTTP status and headers, including Daapi-Request-Id and Daapi-Warnings.

scenarios.name: unknown_fields_and_enum_values_are_tolerated
scenarios.description: Additive changes do not break clients: an unknown response field is ignored and an unknown open-enum value is passed through as a string.

scenarios.name: passthrough_json_is_a_write_without_end_user_header
scenarios.description: endUsers.passthrough takes the end user from the path, fills the integration slug, sends an Idempotency-Key and the qbXML-as-JSON body unchanged.

scenarios.name: sync_timeout_after_send_long_polls_request
scenarios.description: 504 QBD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT (outcome pending) is never resubmitted. The SDK long-polls GET /v1/requests/{id}?waitSeconds=... and returns the typed result once the request succeeds.

scenarios.name: list_early_exit_sends_no_extra_request
scenarios.description: The caller stops iterating after the last item of the first page (take: 2). The next page is fetched only when the iteration needs it, so no continue request reaches QuickBooks.

scenarios.name: base_url_ending_in_v1_is_normalized
scenarios.description: A base URL that already ends in /v1 (Conductor's form, https://api.conductor.is/v1) is accepted; requests go to /v1/..., never /v1/v1/....

scenarios.name: default_headers_are_sent_and_sdk_headers_win
scenarios.description: Client default headers are sent on every request. Headers the SDK manages (Authorization, Daapi-End-User-Id, Idempotency-Key, Content-Type, Accept) take precedence over a default header with the same name.

scenarios.name: total_timeout_bounds_the_whole_call
scenarios.description: totalTimeoutMs caps the whole call: the attempt is cut off when the total budget ends even though the per-attempt timeout is longer, and no retry starts after the budget is spent. The call raises the client-timeout error.

scenarios.name: conductor_end_user_id_alias
scenarios.description: SDKs with a Conductor-named per-call end-user option (Node.js conductorEndUserId, Python conductor_end_user_id) send it as Daapi-End-User-Id, overriding the client default.

scenarios.name: conductor_end_user_id_conflict_fails_locally
scenarios.description: Passing the end user under both names with different values fails before any request is sent.
